author: Chang Cheng
status: decision_rule_frozen_before_new_runs; concrete shortlists pending training-only Stage 1
purpose: Select exactly one operationally qualified CD/SPA and percentile/absolute combination for an initial package-wide practical default.

sampling.per_seed: one deterministic permutation; sample sizes are nested prefixes
sampling.validation: exact original 4000 official-validation image IDs sampled with seed 42

numerical_configuration.change_from_initial_run: Iteration cap increased from 10000 to 20000; no tolerance or equations change.

stage_1.scope: Four screened NMF methods: sealed essential checks plus their optional fine grids, with original incumbents explicitly refitted.
stage_1.representation_definition: n_components plus percentile or score_threshold; KNN neighbor count excluded
stage_1.representation_ranking: descending best qualified unrounded mean CV balanced accuracy over k, then frozen canonical candidate order
stage_1.shortlist_rule: qualified original incumbent representation plus top two other qualified pairs; if incumbent unqualified, top three qualified pairs and retained incumbent failure
stage_1.shortfall_rule: Resolve fewer than three qualified pairs in a versioned training-only amendment before Stage 2; no new validation inspection.

stage_2.folds: StratifiedKFold with shuffle and configuration seed; identical within attribute across methods
stage_2.absolute_grid_rule: literal float64 threshold = shortlisted threshold * sqrt(n_train / 4000); no additional unscaled threshold candidates
stage_2.absolute_grid_rule_scope: search heuristic only; raw pooled-t statistic and estimator API unchanged
stage_2.infeasible_tuple_policy: Retain failed/preflight-excluded records with reasons; no silent pruning or validation-informed replacement.
stage_2.selection_metric: mean of five qualified training CV balanced accuracies
stage_2.candidate_tie_rule: exact score ties use frozen canonical candidate order

timing.primary_workload: one final fit plus prediction on the fixed 4000 validation images
timing.order_rule: recorded seeded randomized method order within timing blocks
timing.case_cost: median over three repeats of total_fit_seconds + prediction_seconds
timing.primary_normalization: per-case serial cost divided by fastest operationally qualified method in that case; geometric mean across 18 equally weighted cases
timing.secondary_cost: geometric mean of per-case normalized committed CV tuning compute; includes committed failures and shared cost once
timing.secondary_timing_limitation: parallel worker wall sum; not isolated runtime or CPU time; unmeasured interrupted work excluded and disclosed

decision_rule.qualification: all nine training configurations for both attributes must have qualified selected fits/evaluations and three valid exact-match profiling repeats
decision_rule.no_qualified_method: technical/numerical issue requires recorded repair amendment; do not install an invalid default
decision_rule.attribute_score: arithmetic mean validation balanced accuracy over nine configurations
decision_rule.macro_score: equal arithmetic mean of the two attribute scores
decision_rule.regret_reference: best qualified macro score and best qualified score for each attribute
decision_rule.empty_accuracy_gate: minimize max(macro regret/0.01, each attribute regret/0.02); disclose violated margins
decision_rule.cost_rule: within retained accuracy/fallback set, retain methods with geometric normalized serial cost <= 1.05 times lowest cost

sensitivity.zero_margin_empty_gate: minimum maximum unscaled macro and attribute regret
sensitivity.additional_cost_sensitivity: add recorded parallel CV tuning compute to the serial workload, explicitly labeling different measurement conditions

reporting.uncertainty_scope: paired descriptive differences/ranges across overlapping configurations; no independence-based standard errors

final_holdout.access_after: default, source, numerical settings and final evaluation plan frozen
final_holdout.simulations: complementary diagnostics; not unannounced votes in the CelebA rule
